packageRules.description: Images follow floating tags and watchtower applies their updates, so they are not pinned to digests: a pin would freeze them. watchtower itself is the exception, so it never updates itself unreviewed.
Group the images this stack builds and publishes itself.
Vaultwarden holds the vault data. Keep it on its own PR so it is never merged as part of a batch.
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs rather than moving tags.
